name: Project Quality Management
excerpt: Project Quality Management ensures that a project will satisfy the needs for which it was undertaken.
notes:
- Project Quality Management involves processes and activities that determine quality policies, objectives, and responsibilities.
- It ensures that the project will satisfy the needs for which it was undertaken.

- Project Quality Management utilizes tools and techniques such as Control Charts, the Seven Run Rule, Pareto Charts, and Stratification.
